text: Reiwa 9 (Apr 2027–Mar 2028): no citywide kindergarten dates verified for year-start, summer, winter or year-end. The first three 2027 spans are Rule No. 5 defaults, not annual dates; March 2028 is outside the display year.

Reiwa 9: no citywide elementary year-start, summer, winter or year-end dates verified. Apr 1–7, 2027 is the rule default only; the Reiwa 8 notice set Apr 1–9 in 2026, not 2027. Summer and winter are principal-set; March 2028 is outside the display year.

Reiwa 9: no citywide junior-high year-start, summer, winter or year-end dates verified. Apr 1–7, 2027 is the rule default only. Summer and winter are principal-set; March 2028 is outside the display year. Confirm school-specific variations, including Saikyo affiliated and Rakufu two-term calendars; their Reiwa 8 exception table does not specify year-end dates.

Reiwa 9: no citywide integrated-school year-start, summer, winter or year-end dates verified. The rule leaves dates to principals using elementary or junior-high schedules as a guide. The Reiwa 8 notice's cross-reference to junior high does not establish Reiwa 9 dates.

No dated 2027 city high-school or support-school year-start, summer, autumn (where applicable), winter or year-end closures verified. City high-school Art. 6 gives principal-set windows, not closures throughout those windows. Neither the kindergarten-to-junior-high notice nor the prefectural rule establishes these dates.
Prefectural-school spans are Article 7 defaults for prefecturally administered schools only. School-specific and approved exceptions were not verified; do not apply to municipal or private schools.

Circular 0018/2026 does not standardise summer or local discretionary days. February 18–19, 2027 is the common closure; the longer February 15–19 post-primary break can be shortened and primary schools can opt in. Easter can be shortened by primary schools under contingency arrangements.

Summer is the pupil interval between the June 30 administrative day and September 7 opening, not a named break in the calendars. December winter break is shown as printed; statutory/observed holidays and weekends outside the named break are not extended into it.

Summer is between the June 2 and August 16 instruction boundaries, not a named district closure; some early education sites remain open during recess. This scope covers district calendar breaks, not every non-instructional date or site-specific schedule.
Council pupil dates verified for the stored recesses; staff days and any school-specific divergence are not a separate school-break census.
Statewide breaks checked against Berlin ICS and KMK tables; individual school exceptions are not verified.
